changelog.note: Baseline profile: 94 claims from 20 sources, anchored to fingerprinted passages and support-reviewed in two cold passes; 46 statements corrected, 1 claim dropped (Medigap, unreadable PDF text).
Moved 9 medical debt and bankruptcy claims from problems to the new financial_hardship section (statements and anchors unchanged).

Backfill: 38 claims added from primary sources now reachable (Census CPS ASEC and ACS, NCHS NHIS, CMS NHE, KFF Marketplace denials, AMA prior authorization survey, CFPB medical debt, KFF 2026 Marketplace, GBD HAQ Index); 3 claims re-anchored to PMC full text; cold support review passed all after 4 rewrites.

Backfill round 2 (data older than 10 years): replaced Himmelstein 2009 and Dobkin 2018 bankruptcy estimates with Debt's Grip (via Sickler 2025 review), Scott 2026 (trauma) and Uppal 2025 (cancer); replaced 2016 spending comparison with OECD Health at a Glance 2025 (2024 data); dropped USA-costs-001 (superseded) and USA-outcomes-010 (GBD 2016 state deciles, no GBD 2019 equivalent).
